title: DiffPDE: Masked Diffusion Language Models as PDE Solver
abstract: arXiv:2608.30532v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing approaches for synthesizing Partial Differential Equation (PDE) solvers predominantly rely on autoregressive models, yet their global left-to-right decoding incurs substantial redundancy when addressing inherently localized bugs. In this work, we challenge this inefficient paradigm and propose DiffPDE, a framework leveraging discrete diffusion language models for targeted code repair. By introducing a localized re-masking and infilling strategy, DiffPDE regenerates only erroneous regions while preserving correct context, naturally aligning generation with the sparse nature of PDE errors. Furthermore, to handle coupled bugs requiring sequential interventions, we present Iterative Debugging GRPO (ID-GRPO), a reinforcement learning scheme that enables multi-round debugging within single trajectories via intermediate rewards. translated_title: DiffPDE：掩码扩散语言模型作为偏微分方程求解器
translated_abstract: 现有的偏微分方程（PDE）求解器合成方法主要依赖自回归模型，然而其全局从左到右的解码方式在处理本质上局部化的错误时会产生大量冗余。在本工作中，我们挑战了这种低效范式，提出DiffPDE——一个利用离散扩散语言模型进行针对性代码修复的框架。通过引入局部化重掩码与填充策略，DiffPDE仅重新生成错误区域，同时保留正确的上下文，使生成过程自然契合PDE错误的稀疏特性。此外，为处理需要顺序干预的耦合错误，我们提出了迭代调试GRPO（ID-GRPO），这是一种强化学习方案，通过中间奖励在单条轨迹内实现多轮调试。在PDEBench上的实验表明，DiffPDE达到了有竞争力的精度，优于同等规模的自回归模型。
tldr: 提出DiffPDE框架，利用掩码扩散语言模型的局部重掩码填充策略与迭代调试强化学习方法ID-GRPO，针对PDE求解器代码中的稀疏局部错误进行高效修复，性能超越同等规模的自回归模型。
en_tdlr: DiffPDE leverages masked diffusion language models with a localized re-masking and infilling strategy, combined with an Iterative Debugging GRPO reinforcement learning scheme, to efficiently repair sparse localized bugs in PDE solvers, outperforming same-scale autoregressive models.
